resources.string: To improve the app, Google Firebase Analytics collects screen usage, weather request results, and app, device and installation information. Custom events exclude actual location, address, push tokens and device UUIDs. Usage analytics is on unless you turn it off in this menu; weather remains available either way. Analytics data is not permitted for advertising use. Advertising, crash diagnostics and notifications are handled separately.
